---
name: Feature or fix
about: A player problem with acceptance criteria, for normal and risky changes
---

**Player problem.** One sentence.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Given ___, when ___, the page shows ___.
- [ ] Works with the sample game (the home page's example match), on a phone, and in light mode.

**Out of scope.**

**Tier.** Tiny, normal or risky, and why.

**Touches.** Every file the change should make or edit, each in backticks, all on this one line. A folder in backticks covers everything in it. A ticket that changes no files writes None instead of a list, and can say why after a full stop. The ticket queue reads this line to start only tickets whose files don't overlap.

**Builder.** Claude Code on Opus 5.5, in a local or cloud session. One builder for this ticket.

**Plan** (the builder fills in before coding). Files, data, tests, docs to update.

**How we'll verify.** Test names, preview steps, screenshots.
